ordered_diagnoses: Rheumatoid Arthritis with Central Nervous System Involvement

s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent episodes of neurological deficits with evidence of inflammation and white matter changes
salient_findings: Mild aphasia and confusion
Sudden-onset right leg weakness
Mild headache and right facial droop
Extensive white matter changes on MRI
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
key_facts: History of well-controlled hypertension and hyperlipidemia
On methotrexate and sulfasalazine treatment
Developed mild aphasia and confusion lasting for several hours
Right leg weakness resolved within 2 days
Presented with mild headache and right facial droop
Neurological examination revealed paraphasic errors and word-finding difficulty
Mild right nasolabial flattening and bilateral upgoing plantars
No motor or sensory deficits
Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level
High titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody
CSF analysis showed 12/µL white blood cell count and 4 oligoclonal bands
MRI Brain showed extensive white matter changes with enhancement along the arachnoid surface

shortlist: Rheumatoid Arthritis with Central Nervous System Involvement

shortlist.label: Multiple Sclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent episodes of neurological deficits with evidence of inflammation and white matter changes, CSF analysis showed 4 oligoclonal bands

shortlist.label: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder
shortlist.why_kept: History of recurrent neurological deficits, presence of high titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, and extensive white matter changes on MRI Brain

shortlist.label: Primary Central Nervous System Vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated erythrocyte sedimentation rate and C-reactive protein level, and presence of multinucleated giant cells on brain biopsy

shortlist.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis with Central Nervous System Involvement
shortlist.why_kept: History of rheumatoid arthritis treatment with methotrexate and sulfasalazine, and presence of high titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody

shortlist.label: Hashimoto's Encephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: History of autoimmune disease, presence of lymphocytes and plasma cells on brain biopsy, and recurrent episodes of neurological deficits

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of relapsing neurological symptoms (mild aphasia and confusion, right leg weakness, and right facial droop) with complete or partial resolution, along with the presence of oligoclonal bands in the CSF and extensive white matter changes on MRI, are characteristic of Multiple Sclerosis.

rejected.label: Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder
rejected.why: The absence of optic neuritis and the lack of aquaporin-4 antibody testing results make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Primary Central Nervous System Vasculitis
rejected.why: The brain biopsy did not show evidence of vasculitis, and the MRI findings are not typical for this condition.

rejected.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis with Central Nervous System Involvement
rejected.why: While the patient has a high titer of cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, the neurological symptoms and imaging findings are not typical for CNS involvement in rheumatoid arthritis.

rejected.label: Hashimoto's Encephalopathy
rejected.why: There is no mention of thyroid disease or antibodies, making this diagnosis less likely.
